title: Customer records
description: Customer names, order history, addresses or support tickets visible without logging in.

title: Unreleased pricing or roadmap
description: Price lists, discount tiers or roadmap items that have not been announced publicly.

title: Staging or pre-production marker
description: Staging banners, test data, lorem ipsum or 'do not use' notices on a production hostname.

title: Unexpected third-party widget
description: Chat widgets, trackers or ad units that are not part of the approved vendor list.
